newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't plans fiscal package this year - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't plans fiscal package this year - paper.

text.p: Brazil's government will announce a fiscal package, including revision of pensions and cuts in expenses, by the end of the year to slash 2.5 billion off public accounts, local newspapers said.
The papers said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir announced the package Monday at a meeting with investors at the U.S.-Brazilian Chamber of Commerce in Washington.
Jornal do Brasil said the package could be unveiled as early as next month.

The paper said the package would also include the closing down of dozens of state companies and agencies with personnel costs of about a billion reais and voluntary retirements that would cut some 40,000 workers from public payrolls.
Gazeta Mercantil financial daily said the package will also include a revision of the foirmula used to set public and private pensions.
